meaning:
ἐφάλλομαι
[in LXX for צָלַח, 1Ki.10:6 11:6 16:13 * ;]
to leap upon: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s) Act.19:16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
